train.selection: all completed single-axis pulses with >= original response horizon; load class from own commands; no GT-based rejection; no s1051 fit
train.method: per-profile ordinary least squares mean response; residual NNLS of Nav2 Omni alpha1..5, independently for own-command load states; unobserved profiles keep old fixed means; preserve response horizons
train.noise_floor: existing 0.5 mm xy and 0.001 rad yaw

evaluation.gt: fixed calibration labels only on s1050; s1051 scoring only after predictions

height.method: calibrated single-view metrology: project observed ground contact plus fixed map wall height; independent Canny top-edge support

full_rule: one fresh preregistered S2 solo DEV full only if every gate passes; otherwise no SIM; gap 30s is reported historical target, not extra admission
limitations: s1050 and s1051 already inspected development data; forward holdout of new constants, not independent confirmation; no camera/FOV or common port changes
